source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"failIfNull","var":"input.equipmentId","error_code":"VALIDATION","error_message":"equipmentId is required"},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"input.signalCode","error_code":"VALIDATION","error_message":"signalCode is required"},{"type":"when","then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO emc_machine_signal (signal_id, equipment_id, signal_code, is_auto) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, true)","params":["${input.equipmentId}","${input.signalCode}"]}],"var":"input.isAuto","equals":"true","else":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO emc_machine_signal (signal_id, equipment_id, signal_code, is_auto) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, false)","params":["${input.equipmentId}","${input.signalCode}"]}]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","equipmentId":"${input.equipmentId}","signalCode":"${input.signalCode}"}}]}
